data.title: ChestScan Classifier
data.desc: Chest X-ray classification model for pneumonia, pleural effusion, and cardiomegaly detection. Trained on 100k+ labeled radiographs.
data.indications: Screening for acute chest pathology in emergency and outpatient settings.

data.title: RetinAI Grader
data.desc: Automated diabetic retinopathy severity grading from fundus photographs. Returns ETDRS grade with heatmap overlay.
data.indications: Annual diabetic eye screening programs.

data.title: SkinLesion Detector
data.desc: Dermoscopy image segmentation and classification for melanoma vs benign lesion differentiation.
data.indications: Point-of-care dermoscopy screening in dermatology clinics.

data.title: FractureDetect Pro
data.desc: Orthopedic fracture localization and classification from plain X-rays. Supports long bones, wrist, and ankle.
data.indications: Emergency department triage and urgent care fracture screening.

data.title: BrainTumor Delineator
data.desc: MRI brain tumor boundary delineation using a 3D U-Net architecture. Returns voxel-level segmentation mask.
data.indications: Preoperative tumor volume measurement and treatment planning.

data.title: PolyScope AI
data.desc: Real-time colonoscopy polyp detection model. Processes live video stream and flags polyp regions with bounding boxes.
data.indications: Assisted colonoscopy polyp detection for gastroenterology.

data.title: MammoScreen Pro
data.desc: Mammography mass detection and BI-RADS category scoring. Provides finding coordinates and confidence scores.
data.indications: Screening mammography programs and recall reduction.

data.title: EchoFraction Estimator
data.desc: Echocardiogram ejection fraction estimation from 2D apical four-chamber views. No manual tracing required.
data.indications: Rapid EF assessment in cardiology and ICU settings.

data.title: NoduleTracker CT
data.desc: Lung nodule detection and longitudinal growth tracking from chest CT series. Supports Lung-RADS output.
data.indications: Lung cancer screening programs and incidental nodule follow-up.

data.title: OphthAI Screener
data.desc: Diabetic macular edema grading from color fundus images. Returns DME grade and referral recommendation.
data.indications: Community diabetic eye screening, optometry referral triage.

data.title: ClinicalNER Pro
data.desc: Medical named entity recognition from clinical notes. Extracts diagnoses, medications, procedures, and lab values.
data.indications: EHR data enrichment, clinical coding support, and NLP pipelines.

data.title: DischargeSum AI
data.desc: Automated discharge summary generation from structured EHR data. Produces physician-ready narrative drafts.
data.indications: Post-discharge documentation automation for inpatient and surgical units.

data.title: ICD-10 Coder
data.desc: ICD-10-CM code suggestion from free-text clinical narratives. Returns ranked code list with confidence scores.
data.indications: Medical billing, coding audit, and clinical documentation improvement.

data.title: SentimentRx Analyzer
data.desc: Patient feedback sentiment classification with urgency scoring. Flags negative experiences requiring immediate follow-up.
data.indications: Patient experience programs, complaint triage, and quality improvement.

data.title: RadReport Generator
data.desc: Structured radiology report generation from a list of radiological findings. Produces RSNA-format narrative output.
data.indications: Radiology reporting automation and structured data extraction.

data.title: TriageText Classifier
data.desc: ED triage note severity classification into ESI levels 1–5. Assists with rapid patient acuity assessment.
data.indications: Emergency department triage decision support.

data.title: DrugInteract Extractor
data.desc: Drug-drug interaction mention extraction from prescription text and clinical notes. Classifies interaction severity.
data.indications: Medication reconciliation, pharmacy review, and e-prescribing safety checks.

data.title: ConsentDoc Simplifier
data.desc: Transforms complex patient consent documents into plain-language summaries at a 6th-grade reading level.
data.indications: Patient education, informed consent process support.

data.title: LabFlag Interpreter
data.desc: NLP-based lab result abnormality interpretation. Extracts values, flags out-of-range results, and generates clinical context.
data.indications: Lab result review support in primary care and hospitalist medicine.

data.title: ClinicalQA Responder
data.desc: Medical question answering system grounded in clinical literature. Returns answers with source citations.
data.indications: Clinical decision support, medical education, and literature search augmentation.

data.title: ReadmissionRisk Predictor
data.desc: 30-day hospital readmission risk scoring from structured EHR features at discharge. Returns risk tier and contributing factors.
data.indications: Discharge planning and care transition management.

data.title: SepsisAlert Engine
data.desc: Early sepsis onset prediction from continuous vital signs and lab values. Fires alerts up to 6 hours before clinical recognition.
data.indications: ICU and general ward sepsis early warning.

data.title: DiabetesDx Predictor
data.desc: Type-2 diabetes onset prediction from routine lab values (HbA1c, fasting glucose, BMI, lipid panel).
data.indications: Primary care diabetes screening and prevention programs.

data.title: LOS Forecaster
data.desc: Hospital length-of-stay prediction at admission time using diagnosis, demographics, and comorbidity data.
data.indications: Inpatient bed management and capacity planning.

data.title: DrugResponse Profiler
data.desc: Pharmacogenomics drug response prediction from genetic variant data. Covers 120+ commonly prescribed medications.
data.indications: Precision medicine programs and personalized dosing guidance.

data.title: ChurnPredict Clinical
data.desc: Patient disengagement and care drop-out early warning model. Identifies at-risk patients before they disengage.
data.indications: Patient retention programs in chronic disease management.

data.title: FraudDetect Claims
data.desc: Medical billing fraud and anomaly detection from claims data. Flags suspicious patterns for investigator review.
data.indications: Health insurance fraud detection and claims audit.

data.title: GeneVariant Classifier
data.desc: Pathogenic variant significance classification (Pathogenic / Likely Pathogenic / VUS / Benign) from VCF input.
data.indications: Germline variant interpretation for clinical genetics and oncology.

data.title: SurvivalCurve Modeler
data.desc: Cancer survival probability modeling using Cox PH and deep survival architectures. Generates Kaplan-Meier–style outputs.
data.indications: Oncology prognosis communication and clinical trial stratification.

data.title: CostRisk Estimator
data.desc: Patient treatment cost risk stratification model. Predicts high-cost episodes 90 days in advance from claims history.
data.indications: Population health management and care management program targeting.
